en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Abu Nasr, from Abdul Kareem, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘I said to him<sup>asws</sup>, ‘The man permits to his brother, the private part of his slave girl’.
He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Yes, for him is what he permits for him from her’.
